note: Where to study, by discipline. Each institution carries its basis: an NIRF India Rankings 2025 rank (the main source — the latest published when this was written; NIRF 2026 had not appeared), or 'Suggested — check' where no ranking covers the field, which is a judgement and is always shown as one. Public and private institutions are both listed. The official links show at once; the institution lists stay hidden until the owner has read them (review.reviewed_by_owner). The monthly study bot (housekeeping/studyRefresh.js) proposes changes; the admin approves them.

review.note: Owner gate (Round 11): read the institution lists once, then set reviewed_by_owner to true.
